goal: Stop treating the aggregate status of unrelated deployment jobs as the publication readiness owner.
boundaries: Pure offline validation in the existing Actions workflow. No new runtime,provider call,server write,deploy rerun,cron worker or old publication rerun.
criteria: Require the exact approved source,its verify job and strict TLS;all21 accepted publishing blobs must match. Existing runtime installed-source,clean-tree,host,schema,rights,dedup/UNKNOWN gates stay unchanged. A failed unrelated deploy aggregate alone must not veto these verified publishing conditions;bad verify/source/TLS/blob data must still stop.
risks: Only the manually reviewed exact source is admissible. This does not declare the whole failed deployment healthy or authorize another worker. Production service bytes and sealed batch adapter/template are not changed.
